n1.speaker: npc_pell
n1.text: Four forgeries, one hand, every one countersigned through Room 0.

n2.speaker: npc_pell
n2.text: Quill says the Reclaimer-Captain comes up in person when the quota runs short. It runs short tonight.

n3.speaker: npc_pell
n3.text: Be at the Ember Gate after the night bell. Take the Captain's manifest. And come back alive; I hate re-filing.
